comments:
Date of composition: shing pho spre'u'i chu stod gyi zla ba'i tshe 1 (The wood male monkey year of the first day of the month of Āṣāḍha). This could be 1344 or 1404. 1404 is a better hypothesis, as the former date would not allow the identification of the author's teacher named in the colophon (Ye shes rdo rje dpal bzang po (ID:4131)) as the third abbot of gSer ri dgon born in 1343, and would be prior to 1364, the foundation date of the monastery of Rati dga' ldan byams pa gling (ID:5950) named in the colophon as place of composition.

The ornamental title "slob ma la phan pa" echoes that of work (ID:5482).
